text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Both the track and weather conditions
are in line
with the simulations I ran.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(All that's left is to make final
adjustments on the
values once I get to
the venue and have Parcae
put together
a strategy for me...)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
> Start initialization process?
>[y]:

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Even after resetting Parcae with a fresh
install,
they've continued to output
accurate estimates.
Nothing's changed,
but...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: They don't feel the same—like we lost some sorta supernatural connection or something, I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(...I sound like an idiot. Parcae's just a
program.
Really...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Still, I'm half convinced Parcae showed
me the
old fate again just to rile me
up...)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That's enough. I need a quick restart to
clear my
cache too.

text_block_list.name: Newspaper
text_block_list.text:
Battle for the Spring Tenno Sho!
Which
of these titans is coming out on top?
Will
the Overlord seize yet more glory,
or will one of
her rivals steal the show?

text_block_list.name: Web Article
text_block_list.text:
Spring Tenno Sho Exclusive Interview!

Top Runners Claim Their Rivals!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text:
Wow, people sure seem excited about
the spring
Tenno Sho! I didn't realize it
was happening
today.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. I saw some predictions on tv
the other
day. They were ragging on one
of the racers big
time, though. What was
her name again? Air
Shakur?

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text: She's gotta be a massive jerk for them to talk about her like that. I get that she's up against some absolute gems, but still... yikes.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: H-hey, shut up! It's her!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: What?! You got somethin' to say to me?!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A & B
text_block_list.text:
Eep!
No, it was nothing!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
If it was really "nothing," they wouldn't
have to
run off in shame, would they?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Well yeah. They never did get to me.
choice_data_list_en: Looks like you're doing okay now.
You seem to be doing fine now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
And the hell's with your reaction? Your
trainee
just scared random people off.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah. Keep dreaming.
choice_data_list: せっかくなら歓声を浴びたいよな
せっかくなら歓声を浴びたいよね
choice_data_list_en: If we're doing this, you want to hear the crowd cheer, right?
If we're doing this, you'd want to hear the crowd cheer, wouldn't you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I honestly... I don't get why they cheer for who they do.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Races call the predicted winner the
"favorite,"
right? Even if it's someone
everyone hates like
me.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I mean sure, there's times where the
"favorite" is
someone popular, but... It
just seems like a dumb
word choice.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Gross... Don't go askin' me such
stupid
questions, idiot!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinkin' about the mental
gymnastics of
it all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah?
choice_data_list: 人によって色んなドラマがあるからな
人によって色んなドラマがあるからね
choice_data_list_en: Everyone has their own personal drama, after all.
Everyone has their own personal drama, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you mean like rivals dukin' it out in a
contest
of dreams and determination?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Just somethin' some troll said a while
back.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Apparently I can never be the "real deal"
without
a rival.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
They said I was lucky to skate by
unchallenged...
It was really annoying.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Well, they'll be eating those words soon

enough—when I shove them down their
throat.
...Right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Hah. You're gettin' good at rilin' me up.
choice_data_list_en: Then you can definitely win, right?
Then you can win this, right?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I'm not gonna get your hopes up with no
proof,
but... I'm not gonna jinx myself
anymore either.

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Oh, they're here, they're here!
Kyaaah!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, the beautiful final notes of spring,
the
loveliest prelude to verdant summer!
That is to
say, I have arrived! Feast your
eyes upon my
glorious visage!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
What's that? You wish for me to blow
you a kiss?
Ask and you shall receive!
There's more than
enough to spare!
Mwah, mwah! ♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead, Doto! 'Tis your turn to set the

spectators' hearts alight!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eep! W-well, um...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: M-mwah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: WOOOOO!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-omigosh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Don't count me out!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the support, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
All your cheers and well wishes are my
strength. I
promise to pay you back with
a wonderful race
between myself and my
equally wonderful rivals!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'm excited to have a no-holds-barred
battle with
you too, Shakur!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Cool story. Not interested.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Man... The way Air Shakur acts... It's not
even
"cool" or edgy anymore, it's just
rude.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, its hard to get excited about her. If she's gonna behave like a total monster, I'd rather she ran like a monster too. I thought that's the kinda person she was, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I dare you all to look at me now and say
I just
got lucky.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(Generations, rivals... Don't push that
crap on me.
I want nothing to do with it.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I'm not runnin' because I want people's
attention.
I run to improve myself.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: You want tenacity? I got it.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
(I don't need anyone expecting anythin'
from me.
They'll learn soon enough what
it really means to
be the real deal.)

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: My rise starts today!
